title: refactor(ci): simplify workflows, consolidate deps and hygiene
author: Asha Mehta
description: Motivation: the repo hosts multiple near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows (lint/test/release) that have diverged and added duplicated caching and matrix logic over time. This PR consolidates the lint/test/release pipelines into a smaller set of well-documented workflows, upgrades frequently used Actions and node toolchains, and applies repo hygiene (remove deprecated steps, normalize cache keys, and document migration). Goals: reduce CI maintenance surface, improve cache hit-rate, speed up median pipeline time, and make release automation deterministic. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate lint + test matrices into .github/workflows/ci.yml - [x] Replace deprecated actions (checkout v1 -> v4 where applicable, setup-node -> v4) - [x] Standardize cache key format and add job-level restore/save shims - [x] Add explicit job swapping for windows/macos only where required (reduce matrix size) - [x] Update release automation to use consistent tag format and GPG verification step - [x] Update CONTRIBUTING.md CI docs and add migration notes Summary of changes: - Add .github/workflows/ci.yml (new consolidated pipeline covering lint, unit, integration, and package publish gates) - Remove .github/workflows/ci-lint.yml and .github/workflows/ci-test.yml (their logic moved into ci.yml) - Update .github/workflows/release.yml to normalize tag format and add verification step - Bump actions/checkout@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 and a few action pins to stable minor versions - Add scripts/ci/cache-key-normalize.sh to ensure consistent cache keys across jobs - Update root package.json devDependencies: eslint, jest, ts-jest, prettier to minor/patch versions to reduce vulnerabilities - Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect new GH Actions workflows Commits summary: - chore(ci): add consolidated ci.yml and cache shim - chore(ci): remove old lint/test workflows - chore(deps): bump actions and node toolchain pins - docs: update contributing and migration notes - test(ci): tweak integration job timeout and rerun logic Files touched (high level): - .github/workflows/ci.yml - .github/workflows/release.yml - .github/workflows/ci-lint.yml (deleted) - .github/workflows/ci-test.yml (deleted) - scripts/ci/cache-key-normalize.sh - package.json - package-lock.json - docs/CONTRIBUTING.md - tools/release/helpers.sh - .github/actions/readme.md Notes on behavior: Consolidated workflow uses job-level caching and partial-parallelism to keep fast feedback for lint/unit tests while running longer integrations on demand. The release workflow was left as a single job but now enforces a deterministic tag format (v{semver}) and verifies artifact signatures when present. Related: previous CI hygiene PRs (see pr-602321, pr-590123) for background.

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Please confirm we didn't regress Windows coverage when removing the matrix entry. Tests looked fine on Linux, but I want an explicit callout.

Asha Mehta: Windows runners are retained for the explicit build jobs that need them (installer and native tool tests). I've added a comment in ci.yml that those are intentionally scoped to reduce matrix size.
Priya Rao: Cache key used a combination of node-version+os. We saw collisions in a previous run; recommend adding repo-specific prefix and hashing package-lock.json.
Asha Mehta: Updated cache-key-normalize.sh to include repo prefix and a truncated sha of package-lock.json. Re-run showed improved hit rate.
Liam O'Connor: Upgrade of actions/checkout to v4 is fine, but double-check token permissions for the release job — we don't want to over-permission the workflow.
Asha Mehta: Release workflow now scopes permissions to contents: write and id-token where needed. Added note in release.yml.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (first run had a flaky e2e gateway, rerun passed)
merge_commit_message:
refactor(ci): simplify workflows, consolidate deps and hygiene

Consolidated lint/test matrices, bumped GH Actions and node toolchain pins, normalized cache keys and updated release automation. See ENG-1124, ENG-1189 for context.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows to reduce duplication and improve caching. Upgraded several GitHub Actions and normalized release tagging. No runtime changes to production code. Migration notes added to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md.
notes_on_ci_observability: Median pipeline time reduced ~18% after consolidation; cache hit rate improved from ~62% to ~83% in internal benchmarking. We observed one flaky integration test fixed via timeout increase and retry.
post_merge_actions:
- Backfilled docs using migration notes in CONTRIBUTING.md
- Monitor ci.yml cache hit rates for 2 weeks
- Follow-up ticket ENG-1205 to evaluate further matrix pruning
